'''Neree''' was a celestial body<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> located in the [[Neree system/Legends|Neree system]], a part of the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|intelligence]] agent [[Lesle Andreya]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] at Neree<ref name="WbC" /> around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="AndreyaDate">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to approximately [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. Furthermore, since ''Wanted by Cracken'' states that [[Lesle Andreya]] is age 28, she must have been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> Andreya spoke with a slight Neree [[Language|accent]],<ref name="WbC" /> and around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]<ref name="AndreyaDate" /> her origin was noted by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] in ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'', a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] that served as a compilation of reports on various threats to the New Republic.<ref name="WbC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Neree was mentioned in the [[1993]] sourcebook [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], which was written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="WbC" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Neree [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Neree itself, in grid square S-9.<ref name="TEA" />
